name: 潮汐
author: DeepSeek Harness assistant
tagline: 极光潮汐背景 · 浮动工作窗口 · 鲸鱼娘挂件 · 全可调液态玻璃
description: DSH 潮汐主题：极光星云与海浪潮汐交织的动态背景，界面全面液态玻璃化；左侧工作区变成可拖动、可折叠的悬浮窗口，右下角陪伴 Q 版鲸鱼娘挂件（点击打开玻璃调节面板），浅色/深色各自独立配色，液态玻璃参数全局 + 各区域独立可调。卸载完整还原官方界面。
taglineEn: Aurora-tide backdrop · floating workspace · whale-girl companion · fully tunable liquid glass
descriptionEn: DSH Tide skin: aurora nebula fused with rolling sea-tide animation; full liquid-glass UI; left workspace becomes a draggable, collapsible floating window; a Q-version DeepSeek whale-girl companion sits in the corner — click her to open the glass tuning panel. Light & dark each have their own palette. Glass parameters are tunable globally and per region. Unloading fully restores the official UI.
